description: Defines the intra_slice_scheduler class responsible for scheduling UEs within a network slice, including methods for slot indication, post-processing, and UL/DL scheduling, along with internal context management.

classes.name: intra_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class for intra-slice UE scheduling, managing slot-based scheduling, candidate generation, and resource allocation.

classes.name: slice_ue_group_scheduler
classes.description: Internal structure managing UE groups for a specific slice, including candidate filling and scheduling offsets.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets or updates scheduler state at the beginning of a new slot.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Finalizes scheduling decisions after UE grants are allocated.

methods.name: dl_sched
methods.description: Schedules downlink grants for a specific slice.

methods.name: ul_sched
methods.description: Schedules uplink grants for a specific slice.

methods.name: can_allocate_pdsch
methods.description: Checks if a UE can be scheduled for downlink (PDSCH) in the current slot.

methods.name: can_allocate_pusch
methods.description: Checks if a UE can be scheduled for uplink (PUSCH) in the current slot.

methods.name: create_newtx_dl_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new downlink transmission candidate for a UE.

methods.name: create_newtx_ul_candidate
methods.description: Creates a new uplink transmission candidate for a UE.

methods.name: prepare_newtx_dl_candidates
methods.description: Prepares downlink transmission candidates for scheduling.

methods.name: prepare_newtx_ul_candidates
methods.description: Prepares uplink transmission candidates for scheduling.

methods.name: schedule_dl_newtx_candidates
methods.description: Schedules new transmission candidates for downlink.

methods.name: schedule_ul_newtx_candidates
methods.description: Schedules new transmission candidates for uplink.

methods.name: max_pdschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of PDSCHs that can be allocated.

methods.name: max_puschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of PUSCHs that can be allocated.

methods.name: update_used_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Updates the bitmap of used downlink VRBs.

methods.name: update_used_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Updates the bitmap of used uplink VRBs.
